text: Bombas offers free standard shipping on US orders of 75 dollars or more, after discount and before tax.

evidence.quote: Free for orders $75+ (after discount, before tax): 5 - 10 business days

text: Orders under 75 dollars pay a flat 7.95 dollar standard shipping rate.

evidence.quote: $7.95 (flat rate for orders under $75): 5 - 10 business days

value: Happiness Guarantee, 30 day standard return window (60 days for Nov-Dec purchases)
text: Bombas backs purchases with its Happiness Guarantee and a 30 day return window, extended to 60 days for holiday season purchases.

evidence.quote: products may only be returned for a refund within 30 days of purchase (or within 60 days of purchase for purchases made during the holiday season (i.e., November and December))

text: Bombas prices socks and underwear as singles or in 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 12 packs, with a per pack price that discounts against buying singles.
